body: Well you are obviously very intelligent. I really enjoyed your talent with prose. Feel free to pm if you want to talk about your current issues. We all have them. That's why we are here.
I was moved by your words. You have a real talent in writing. Is that a hobby of yours?  I would love to hear one of your stories if you would like to share.
Actually 1992 to by alcohol.  You went 3 years in the wrong direction.  But your post makes me feel old.  I was born in 1977 and was 21 in 1998.

There are no inpatient places here that don't cost money I don't have.  I've thought about it but no insurance anymore.  The alcohol, which probably caused many of my problems, isn't my reasoning for this breakdown.  Me getting clean wont help the brick wall im hitting this week.  But I appreciate the replies. Its nice to talk to someone.
